question_text: A 16-year-old girl with celiac disease is brought to the physician because of a 1-week history of generalized weakness and tingling around her mouth and in her fingertips. She also complains of abdominal cramps and nausea. In addition to following a gluten-free diet, she has been following a vegan diet for the past 2 years. Physical examination shows involuntary contractions of the muscle at the corner of her mouth and nose that are elicited by tapping on her right cheek. Her parathyroid hormone concentration is 834 pg/mL. Which of the following is the most likely underlying cause for this patient's current condition?
